note: Ten Clermont shake shops as in-game NPC stalls. Gold only. Do not replace this catalog if it already lists all ten.

shops.name: The Shake Bar
shops.blurb: Neon milkshake bar. The Cool Down is the signature best-seller.
shops.examine: A humming neon stall on Hwy 50. The Cool Down board is worn smooth from pointing.
shops.greeting: Welcome in, sugar. Cool Down's the one everyone off 50 asks for. Creamy Dream if you want cookies. Biscoff Max if you need a kick.

shops.name: Steak n Shake
shops.blurb: Diner shakes. Same building as The Shake Bar, separate stall.
shops.examine: A yellow-and-black diner window sharing the 2545 pad with The Shake Bar.
shops.greeting: Same lot as Mira's neon hut. Ours come in a diner glass. Vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, or the black-and-white.

shops.name: Ritter's Frozen Custard
shops.blurb: Frozen custard just across Hwy 50 from the 2545 lot.
shops.examine: Pink-and-cream stand at 2560 E Hwy 50. The drum never quite stops turning.
shops.greeting: Custard's denser than ice cream. That's the point. Get it before the Florida air wins.

shops.name: Bruster's
shops.blurb: Ice cream in Building H. Cookie dough and birthday cake lead the board.
shops.examine: A red-roof scoop shop tucked in Building H at 2450 E Hwy 50.
shops.greeting: Building H, don't get lost in the plaza. Cookie dough or birthday cake?

shops.name: Baskin-Robbins
shops.blurb: Classic scoops on the west end of Hwy 50.
shops.examine: Pink spoons, brown-and-blue awning, 1110 E Hwy 50.
shops.greeting: Thirty-one is a mood, not a quota. Gold Medal Ribbon if you cannot choose.

shops.name: Culver's
shops.blurb: Concrete Mixers off Johns Lake Rd.
shops.examine: Blue-and-white hut that smells like butterburgers and frozen custard.
shops.greeting: Concretes are eaten upside down. That's how you know. Butterscotch, mint Oreo, or strawberry?

shops.name: Five Guys
shops.blurb: Custom shakes on Hancock. Bacon is not a joke here.
shops.examine: Red-and-white check, peanuts on the floor, 1600 N Hancock Rd.
shops.greeting: Tell me a flavor. Bacon malt is the dare. Peanut butter is the hug.

shops.name: Dairy Queen
shops.examine: Red roof on US 27. A Blizzard sits upside down on the counter as a threat and a promise.
shops.greeting: 34714 represent. Oreo, Reese's, or turtle pecan. We flip it. You gasp.

shops.name: McDonald's
shops.examine: Gold arches catching the Hwy 50 dusk. The shake machine is, for once, on.
shops.greeting: Machine's working. Don't jinx it. Chocolate heals, vanilla cools, strawberry perks you up.

shops.name: Wendy's
shops.blurb: Clermont Frosty. Spoon or straw, we do not take sides.
shops.examine: Red pigtails on the sign. The Frosty machine hums like a happy fridge.
shops.greeting: Frosty is a texture. Chocolate for HP, vanilla for a little speed. Don't rush it.
